title: Induction Machine Direct Torque Control (Single-Phase)
text: 单相感应电机直接转矩控制，输入 4 路、输出 2 路；{Control mode} 控制模式 Speed、{Rated electrical frequency (Hz)} 指定额定电频率、{Number of pole pairs} 指定极对数、{Main winding stator resistance, Ras (Ohm)} 指定主绕组定子电阻、{Auxiliary winding stator resistance, Rbs (Ohm)} 指定辅助绕组定子电阻、{Auxiliary/main windings turn ratio} 指定辅助绕组与主绕组的匝数比、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间、{Speed controller proportional gain} 指定速度控制器比例增益、{Speed controller integral gain} 指定速度控制器积分增益、{Speed controller integral anti-windup gain} 指定速度控制器积分抗饱和增益、{Maximum torque (Nm)} 指定最大转矩、{Minimum torque (Nm)} 指定最小转矩、{Rated flux (Wb)} 指定额定磁链、{Flux hysteresis band (Wb)} 指定磁链滞环带、{Torque hysteresis band (Nm)} 指定转矩滞环带，按实例取值。

params.name: Control mode
params.values: 指定控制模式 Speed control (default) | Torque control

params.name: Rated electrical frequency (Hz)
params.values: 指定额定电频率 60 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Main winding stator resistance, Ras (Ohm)
params.values: 指定主绕组定子电阻 1.8180 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Auxiliary winding stator resistance, Rbs (Ohm)
params.values: 指定辅助绕组定子电阻 6.4260 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Auxiliary/main windings turn ratio
params.values: 指定辅助绕组与主绕组的匝数比 1.1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Speed controller proportional gain
params.values: 指定速度控制器比例增益 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Speed controller integral gain
params.values: 指定速度控制器积分增益 10 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Speed controller integral anti-windup gain
params.values: 指定速度控制器积分抗饱和增益 1000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Maximum torque (Nm)
params.values: 指定最大转矩 5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Rated flux (Wb)
params.values: 指定额定磁链 0.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Flux hysteresis band (Wb)
params.values: 指定磁链滞环带 0.02 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Torque hysteresis band (Nm)
params.values: 指定转矩滞环带 0.1 (default) | positive scalar
